content: Giwekikaluru Goyakalunu ga wa giwekikaluru Kristo kamnixjeru giyakatyachri

Nushinikanune, gi galixanna pejnuruneko giwekikalurune, seyni gimata getanna gikta Goyakalu giyakatyachinni. Gi rixanu gi gepikna gixashatachine Goyakalu tokanu geneklewatachine tyechijne gipgujewniyachine.
Tye chinanu gimatanru Goyakalunu Giwekikaluru. Pejnuruneko giwekikalurune Geso Kristo gipgujtatachine wa manchi runyatka, walenwa Goyakalu giyakatyachrini.

Ga wa pejnuruneko giwekikalurune wa Geso mupgujtatkatu, gi wa Goyakalu giyakatyachrini wale. Ga wa walenwa Kristo kamnixachri, wa gixa yijnakpiranyegitanru wa ginachripni. Ga wa xawakni tyechijnetkalu.
Wiwine, gixni wa Goyakalu giyakatyachingi. Gixa gaalixatkana Kristo kamnixachine. Gi rixanu tsrupotni wa gixa gwachri Giwekikaluru Kpashiri wa tyechijne gwachri pnute.
Wannanwa tyechijne giyakatyachinni. Giyagni tyechijne gajene pixka rixa yanumsaletna, ga wa tyechijne gajene yijnakotna.

Wixni wa Goyakalu wgenenwu. Wa Goyakalu gimatachri yijnakotwu. Wa Goyakalu mwugenetanutu gi wa yijnakotwu. Tye chinanu wumatlu Giwekikaluru galikakpotu, ga wa giwekikaluru kamchinu pupjekaklewatachri.
Goyakalni gishiniklewlu
Nushinikanune, wushiniikakanu, gi rixanu gishiniklewlunwa Goyakalu giyakatyachri. Girukokta gishiniklewata Goyakalu wugenetika, ga wa rumatlu Goyakalu.
Mushiniklewatkatu gi gimatlu Goyakalu. Gi rixanu Goyakalni kgishiniklewakleru.
Tyeya gipgujetkalurni Goyakalu gishiniklewle wixa chinanu, gi rixanu Goyakalu tyechijne yokanatlu satupjerutu Wale Wugenetanru, Wale chinanu wuwekinripa.
Tye chinanu waneru gishiniklewlu. Gi wa wixako wushinikalchinanru Goyakalu, seyni wa Wale gishinikalchinanwu. Ga wa yokanatlu Gituru wmukochire gipekole rixinripa.
Nushinikanune, Goyakalu wane gixa gishinikletwu, wixa koxa gimkata gishiniikakleta.
Gi pagogneko gi satuna getlu Goyakalu. Wa wushiniikakini, Goyakalu gwawu ga wa rushiniikakpotutwu.
Gishiniklewlu mmagatikatu maleka giknoklu piklu
Tye chinanu wumata Wale gawinri, ga wa wixa rawinri Wale, gi rixanu renekwu Giwekikaluru Walenu.
Ga wa wixa getlu, ga wa wupgujtatlu Girchi yokanatlu Gituru wa tye psolchijne gajeneko Gognetkakachri rixinripa.
Girukokta gipgujtatlu Geso Goyakalu Wgene rixinri, Goyakalu gwalu ga wa wale Goyakalu gwa.
Ga wa wixa gimatatkalu ga wa walixatkalu rushiniklewle wa Goyakalu gishinikyawu. Goyakalni kgishiniklewakleru, ga wa yineru gishiniklewgognenatachri Goyakalu rawa ga wa Goyakalu gwalu wale.
Tyeya mmagatikatu rixkaaka gishiniklewlu wixa gajiya, kgaponshinikanuklerunepwu gitakyagokikolgognepa. Gi rixanu Kristo gwiyawaka pixka waneko pixka wixa gwaleta tyechijneya.
Maleshlu piklu gishiniklewlu yegi. Seyni gishiniklewlu mmagatikatu maleka giknoklu piklu. Gi rixanu piklu waneya salewnalu. Kpiklegolu magatyalu gishiniklewlu.
Wixa gishiniklu Goyakalu gi rixanu Wale gapka gishinikwu.
Girukokta wane chinini, “Gita gishiniklu Goyakalu,” ga wa rayegixlu gimole, kayroklerni. Gi rixanu mushinikmoletkatu wa retanru, gi rumkata gishinikletlu Goyakalu wa ma metanutu.
Ga wa wixa waneya tye yokanru Goyakalu yokanatyawu, wa Goyakalu gishinikachri rushinikankoxlu gimole.
